name: Amulet of Incineration
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare*

---

Crafted from a gem made from the elemental dust of an entropic flame set within a bone talisman, and glazed in the blood of an aberration, this amulet shimmers with an internal, ever-burning fire.

Once per turn, when you cast a spell that deals Fire damage using a spell slot, you can choose one target that was dealt Fire damage by the spell to gain the Burning (3d6 Fire) condition.

**Crafting.** Creating an Amulet of Incineration requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Animus from an Elemental
- **[Bones].** Spine from a Monstrosity
- **[Dust].** Elemental Dust from an Entropic Flame
- **[Fluid].** Monster Blood from an Aberration

name: Amulet of Primal Wisdom
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare (Requires Attunement)*

---

Crafted from the dried leaves of magical plants and imbued with their dust, this amulet is decorated with a singular dried flower and then encased in sap. The pendant glows softly with the light of springtime and smells of floral fields in bloom.

Your Wisdom score is 19 while you wear this magic amulet. It has no effect on you if your Wisdom is 19 or higher without it.

name: Aqua Delerium
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, rare*

---

This purple potion glows dimly with octarine light. It swirls and sparkles in its small, stoppered bottle.

When you drink this potion, you regain expended spell slots. Roll 1d6. You choose spell slots to regain which have a combined level equal to or less than the result. None of the slots can be higher than level 5.

For one hour after drinking Aqua Delerium, roll 1d20 each time you cast a spell of level 1 or higher. On a 1, you trigger a random Arcane Anomalies.

If you consume more than one dose of Aqua Delerium before finishing a Long Rest|XPHB, you take 1d12 Necrotic damage for each spell slot level regained from the second dose, and your Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. This damage can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

When a creature who cannot cast spells using spell slots drinks Aqua Delerium, it takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and gains one level of Contamination.

**Crafting.** Creating Aqua Delerium requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Dust].** Aberrant Dust
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Organ].** Any Glands

name: Aqua Expurgo
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, rare*

---

This bright orange fluid is stored in a syringe and charged with arcane magic. You can use a Utilize action to administer the shot directly to the heart of yourself or another willing creature.

You are protected against Contamination for six hours after receiving a dose of Aqua Expurgo. During this time, whenever you fail a saving throw against an effect which would cause you to gain one or more Contamination levels, you can choose to succeed instead. You can use this ability three times, after which the effects of Aqua Expurgo expire.

If the effects of Aqua Expurgo expire in this manner, you immediately take 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage and become Incapacitated for 1 minute while you violently retch corrupt bile. Your Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You die if this effect reduces your Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum to 0. The Necrotic damage can't be reduced or prevented by any means.

**Crafting.** Creating Aqua Expurgo requires a Rare Workshop  and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Dust].** Aberrant Dust
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Organ].** Flower from a Plant (traditionally an Eldritch Lily)

name: Bracers of Arc Lightning
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare (Requires Attunement)*

---

These bracers are crafted with fine leathers decorated with magical scales, washed in elemental fluids, elemental dust, and contaminated ichor. The animus used must be from a creature that deals Lightning damage, allowing the bracers to channel the element.

While wearing these magic bracers you gain Resistance|XPHB to Lightning damage and Immunity|XPHB to the Shocked condition.

These magic bracers have six charges, and regain all expended charges each day at dawn. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, you can expend one charge from the bracers to deal an extra 3d6 Lightning damage to the target. A target which takes this damage has the Shocked condition until the start of your next turn.

**Crafting.** Creating Bracers of Arc Lightning requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Animus from a creature that deals Lightning damage (such as a Blue Dragon)
- **[Dust].** Elemental Dust
- **[Fluid].** Elemental Fluid
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Hide].** Skin
- **[Hide].** Scales

**Special.** A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

name: Charged Gauntlets
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, very rare (by a monk)*

---

These light gauntlets are made from cloth woven from the hair of a fiend and reinforced with the scales of a dragon. The gauntlets are washed with an alchemical formula made from elemental fluid and undead dust. They are then powered with a rare animus collected from an aberration.

Each time you hit with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB while attuned to these magic gauntlets they gain one charge. The gauntlets can have up to 10 charges. Any unexpended charges disappear when you take a Long Rest|XPHB or roll Initiative|XPHB.

While the gauntlets have at least one charge, your Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes deal Lightning damage instead of its normal damage type.

While the gauntlets have 5 or more charges, your Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes deal an additional 2d6 Lightning damage and push the target 10 feet away from you on a hit.

You can expend 2 charges from the gauntlets to cast the Shield spell.

You can expend 10 charges from the gauntlets to cast Destructive Wave or Wall of Force, using your monk's focus saving throw DC.

**Crafting.** Creating Charged Gauntlets requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberrant Animus
- **[Dust].** Undead Dust
- **[Fluid].** Elemental Fluid
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fiend
- **[Hide].** Scales from a Blue or Bronze Dragon

name: Chip
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 0.25 lb | **Value:** 10 gp

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

Delerium Harvesting.

Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

Uses for Delerium.

Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

Spell Component.

Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

Magic Items.

Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

Stable Delerium.

The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

Delerium Dust.

Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Cold Snap Circlet
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare*

---

name: Crimson Double-Bladed Scimitar
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 2d4 slashing | **Properties:** Special, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 6 lb | **Value:** 100 gp

---

A blood-red ichor drips down this sword's darkened steel blade. The sword is coated in sanguine witch blood. The dust of dead vampires is forged into the steel of the blade, giving it its blackened sheen. The edge is then empowered by the heart of a dragon. Its gold hilt wrapped in crimson leathers and a bloodred ruby plucked from the corpse of a Sanguine Witch. The fangs of vampires decorate the pommel.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic sword.

Any a creature you hit with this weapon that isn't a Construct or Undead takes an extra 3d6 Necrotic damage, and you regain Hit Points|XPHB equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

**Curse.** While attuned to this blade, you can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of its occupants.

**Crafting.** Creating a Crimson Blade requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Undead Animus from a Sanguine Witch
- **[Dust].** Undead Dust from any Vampire
- **[Fluid].** Monster Blood from an Undead
- **[Natural Weapons].** Teeth from any Vampire
- **[Organ].** Heart from a Dragon

**Special.** If you attack with a double-bladed scimitar as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action immediately after to make a melee attack with it. This attack deals 1d4 slashing damage on a hit, instead of 2d4.

name: Crystal
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 2 lb | **Value:** 1000 gp

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Double-Bladed Scimitar Between Worlds
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 2d4 slashing | **Properties:** Special, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 6 lb | **Value:** 100 gp

---

This otherworldly blade is made from starmetal steel; a potent alloy produced by combining iron with carbon extracted from the bones of powerful aberrant creatures.  During the forging process, the blade is quenched in the spinal fluids of a Far Dweller to draw out extraplanar forces. The resulting metal has an octarine sheen that reflects possible worlds and other realities. The grip and crossguard are decorated with the barbs and leather of a Warp Marauder, and the pommel is set with a crystal containing the eldritch essence of a Far Dweller that powers the weapon's magic.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this magic weapon.

Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit|XPHB or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB using this weapon, immediately after the attack you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 120 feet you can see. Additionally, once per turn when you teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another creature while wielding this weapon, you can make one weapon attack against that creature with this weapon as part of the same action or Bonus Action|XPHB made to teleport.

While holding the blade, you can use a Magic action to cast Dimension Door. Once you do, you must finish a short or Long Rest|XPHB before you can use this feature again.

**Curse.** You have Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws against any spell or other effect which would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane of existence.

**Crafting.** Creating a Sword Between Worlds requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberration Animus
- **[Bones].** Skull, Spine, or Ribs from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor from a Far Dweller
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration
- **[Natural Weapon].** Tentacles from a Warp Marauder

**Special.** If you attack with a double-bladed scimitar as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action immediately after to make a melee attack with it. This attack deals 1d4 slashing damage on a hit, instead of 2d4.

name: Fragment
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 0.5 lb | **Value:** 100 gp

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Frozen Breastplate
descriptionMarkdown:
*Medium Armor, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Armor Class:** 14 | **Weight:** 20 lb | **Value:** 400 gp

---

This armor channels cold energy through carefully manufactured veins of elemental fluid that run along the inside of its frame. Elemental dust is mixed with the gold in its forming, and contaminated ichor is used as a catalyst to magnify the magical effects. The animus gem placed centrally upon it must be infused with the energy of a frost giant.

While attuned to this armor you have Resistance|XPHB to Cold damage and are Immunity|XPHB|Immune to the Frozen condition.

This magical armor has six charges, and regains all expended charges each day at dawn. When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 charge from the armor to freeze your attacker in place. The creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be Frozen (DC 15).

**Crafting.** Creating Frozen Armor requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Animus from a Frost Giant
- **[Dust].** Elemental Dust
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Fluid].** Elemental Fluid

This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.

name: Geode
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 20 lb | **Value:** 5000 gp

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

Delerium Properties.

All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

  • Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
  • Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
  • Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
  • Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.
Delerium Hazards.

When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

Delerium Harvesting.

Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

Uses for Delerium.

Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

Spell Component.

Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

Magic Items.

Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

Stable Delerium.

The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

Delerium Dust.

Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

descriptionMarkdown:

**Damage:** 1d8 piercing | **Properties:** Ammunition, Heavy, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 2 lb

---

This bow is hand-carved carefully from the bones of a dryad and stained in the undead blood of vampires. Strung with the hair of a banshee with a powerful wraith animus is placed within the handle. Once the bow's crafting is complete, it fades from its physical form into a semi-corporeal form.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic longbow.

The bow produces its own spectral ammunition which deals Force damage instead of Piercing damage. The ammunition disappears when it hits or misses a target.

While attuned to this weapon, you can use a Bonus Action|XPHB to see into the Ethereal Plane and see all invisible creatures and objects until the end of your turn. Additionally, you can see through all walls and solid objects within 60 feet of you until the end of your turn. During this time, ammunition fired from this bow passes through solid objects, and you can target enemies within 60 feet of you with your ranged attacks, even if they are behind total cover. You can use this Bonus Action|XPHB only if you haven't moved during your turn. After you use the Bonus Action|XPHB, your Speed|XPHB becomes 0 until the end of your turn.

- **[Dust].** Undead Dust
- **[Fluid].** Ectoplasm
- **[Fluid].** Monster Blood from an Undead
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Banshee

name: Giant Femur Club
descriptionMarkdown:
*Simple Weapon, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d8 bludgeoning | **Properties:** Two-Handed | **Weight:** 10 lb

---

This club is made from the cleaned and polished femur of a giant, crafted finely into a usable two-handed club. Its tapered hilt is wrapped in stained leather. Fastened to the top of the club is a large troll skull with several monstrous teeth embedded into it like a bone morningstar, giving the weapon a grim appearance. The club is imbued with elemental power from the animus used to power the weapon, which causes it to crackle with elemental power.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic greatclub, and you have Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls made against Giants.

While attuned to this club you deal an additional 2d6 damage of the type associated with the elemental dust infused into it.

- **[Bone].** Skull from a Troll
- **[Bone].** Bone from a Giant
- **[Dust].** Elemental Dust from a Troll
- **[Hide].** Skin from a Monstrosity

The dust component determines the additional damage the club deals. For example, dust from a Storm Troll deals Lightning damage, and dust from an Eldritch Troll causes the club to deal Necrotic damage.

name: Greatsword Between Worlds
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 2d6 slashing | **Properties:** Heavy, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 6 lb | **Value:** 50 gp

---

This otherworldly blade is made from starmetal steel; a potent alloy produced by combining iron with carbon extracted from the bones of powerful aberrant creatures.  During the forging process, the blade is quenched in the spinal fluids of a Far Dweller to draw out extraplanar forces. The resulting metal has an octarine sheen that reflects possible worlds and other realities. The grip and crossguard are decorated with the barbs and leather of a Warp Marauder, and the pommel is set with a crystal containing the eldritch essence of a Far Dweller that powers the weapon's magic.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this magic weapon.

Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit|XPHB or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB using this weapon, immediately after the attack you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 120 feet you can see. Additionally, once per turn when you teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another creature while wielding this weapon, you can make one weapon attack against that creature with this weapon as part of the same action or Bonus Action|XPHB made to teleport.

While holding the blade, you can use a Magic action to cast Dimension Door. Once you do, you must finish a short or Long Rest|XPHB before you can use this feature again.

**Curse.** You have Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws against any spell or other effect which would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane of existence.

**Crafting.** Creating a Sword Between Worlds requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberration Animus
- **[Bones].** Skull, Spine, or Ribs from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor from a Far Dweller
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration
- **[Natural Weapon].** Tentacles from a Warp Marauder

When played, this instrument reverberates with draconic whispers and enchantment that drift subtly within the notes that are struck, giving the music a sense of foreboding and palpable charm. Crafted from finely polished ivory and imbued with the animus of a fey creature, the true magic of this harp comes from the finely crafted strings made from combining the sinew of a dragon's heart chords and the hair of a fey, willingly given out of kindness.

name: Injector's Crossbow, Hand
descriptionMarkdown:
*Ranged Weapon, rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d6 piercing | **Properties:** Ammunition, XUA2023PlayersHandbookP7-L, Loading | **Weight:** 3 lb | **Value:** 75 gp

---

This crossbow is covered in metal plating, decorative and refined pointed metal tips along an oak wood body, and foregrip. The barrel and limb are reinforced with the steel plates from a construct, with a stained leather grip made from a monster's hide. Its hair strung bowstring and leather fasteners hold a series of syringes in place. The crossbow's stock has a series of various tubes extruding from it that connect to an alchemical chamber on the side of the weapon. A mechanical wheel feeds the darts into place upon filling them, auto-loading the crossbow for easy firing.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic crossbow. This crossbow ignores LD|XPHB|Loading, and you don't need a free hand to load a piece of ammunition into it.

Once per turn when you hit a creature with a ranged attack using this crossbow, you can apply one of the following poisons.

**Virulent.** The target takes an extra 2d6 Poison damage.

**Weakening.** The target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is Weakened until the start of your next turn.

**Immobilizing.** The target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is Immobilized until the start of your next turn.

**Crafting.** Creating an Injector Crossbow requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Chemical Solution
- **[Hair].** Hair
- **[Hide].** Plates
- **[Hide].** Skin
- **[Natural Weapons].** Needles from an Injector

name: Long Sword Between Worlds
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d8 slashing (or 1d10 slashing versatile) | **Properties:** Heavy, Versatile | **Weight:** 3 lb | **Value:** 2 gp

---

This otherworldly blade is made from starmetal steel; a potent alloy produced by combining iron with carbon extracted from the bones of powerful aberrant creatures.  During the forging process, the blade is quenched in the spinal fluids of a Far Dweller to draw out extraplanar forces. The resulting metal has an octarine sheen that reflects possible worlds and other realities. The grip and crossguard are decorated with the barbs and leather of a Warp Marauder, and the pommel is set with a crystal containing the eldritch essence of a Far Dweller that powers the weapon's magic.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this magic weapon.

Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit|XPHB or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB using this weapon, immediately after the attack you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 120 feet you can see. Additionally, once per turn when you teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another creature while wielding this weapon, you can make one weapon attack against that creature with this weapon as part of the same action or Bonus Action|XPHB made to teleport.

While holding the blade, you can use a Magic action to cast Dimension Door. Once you do, you must finish a short or Long Rest|XPHB before you can use this feature again.

**Curse.** You have Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws against any spell or other effect which would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane of existence.

**Crafting.** Creating a Sword Between Worlds requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberration Animus
- **[Bones].** Skull, Spine, or Ribs from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor from a Far Dweller
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration
- **[Natural Weapon].** Tentacles from a Warp Marauder

name: Manual of Occult Anatomy
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, varies (by an apothecary or warlock)*

---

Filled with diagrams showing humans with alien features, this book of strange medical lore is written in monster-blood ink infused with draconic dust and then etched onto parchment pages made from aberration skin. The manuscript is bound in a scale-clad cover.

You can use this manual as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Apothecary or Warlock spells. When you use the manual as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs of your Apothecary or Warlock spells. In addition, the book contains the knowledge of an Apothecary Esoteric Theory or Warlock Eldritch Invocation up to a level determined by the manual's rarity and chosen when the item is created, which you gain while you are attuned to it. - **[Fluid].** Monster Blood from a Monstrosity
- **[Hide].** Scales
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration

name: Mask of Monstrous Forms
descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, rare (by a druid)*

---

This magic mask is made from the skull of a particular monstrosity (with a Challenge Rating|XPHB of 6 or lower). The skull is carved into a mask, engraved with aberrant dust, and then boiled in a vat of mimic mucus, the flesh of a doppelganger, and acidic bile. Finally, a vessel containing the animus of any creature with the Shapechanger trait is placed upon the forehead of the mask, channeling its shapechanging magic.

While attuned to the mask, you can expend two uses of your Wild Shape feature to transform into the monstrosity associated with the mask, instead of a Beast.

**Crafting.** Creating a Mask of Monstrous Forms requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Fluid].** Acidic Bile
- **[Fluid].** Mucus from a Mimic
- **[Organ].** Flesh from a Doppelganger

** The Monstrosity used for this mask determines the form of the shapechange.*

name: Massive Cluster
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 8000 lb

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Maul of Chaos
descriptionMarkdown:
*Martial Weapon, legendary (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 2d6 bludgeoning | **Properties:** Heavy, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 10 lb | **Value:** 10 gp

---

A hammer of chaos is crafted by melting down the magical plates of otherworldly constructs, infused with both the fluid and dust of elementals. The weapon is then soaked in the grey matter of an aberrant brain. This steel hammer is fitted into a shaft made from fiend skin leather and the ribs of a dragon.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon. This hammer has T|XPHB|Thrown with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 90 feet. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. The hammer deals 2d8 extra damage of the chosen type.

When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, if you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the hammer ricochets to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll if the attack hits. After making this attack, the hammer flies back to your hand.

**Crafting.** Creating the Hammer of Chaos requires a Legendary Workshop and the following Legendary Components:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Bones].** Spine from a Dragon
- **[Dust].** Elemental Dust
- **[Fluid].** Elemental Fluid
- **[Hide].** Plates from a Construct
- **[Hide].** Skin from a Fiend
- **[Organ].** Brain from an Aberration

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Damage:** 1d10 slashing (or 1d12 slashing versatile) | **Properties:** Heavy, Versatile | **Weight:** 6 lb | **Value:** 30 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

The hook-shaped "beard" at the lower edge of the head of a bearded axe gives it its characteristic silhouette and provides a larger cutting edge than standard battle axes without excessively increasing its weight.

**Damage:** 1d10 slashing | **Properties:** Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 11 lb | **Value:** 45 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

Essentially a greataxe with a longer haft, the breidox was developed to deliver a powerful slash to opponents behind a protective shield wall.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

Crafting.

Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

  • [Animus].

    Any Animus

  • [Fluid].

    Sap

  • [Hair].

    Hair from a Fey

  • [Hair].

    Leaves

  • [Hide].

    Bark

*Simple Weapon, rare (by a ranger)*

**Damage:** 1d6 piercing | **Properties:** Thrown | **Weight:** 2 lb | **Value:** 1.50 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

**Upkeep.** When you make an attack roll with a silver weapon or piece of ammunition, it takes a cumulative -1 penalty to attack rolls. The weapon or piece of ammunition is destroyed if the penalty reaches -5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the object or by succeeding on a DC 10 Dexterity check using Smith's Tools as part of a Short Rest|XPHB or Long Rest|XPHB.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

Crafting.

Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

  • [Animus].

    Any Animus

  • [Fluid].

    Sap

  • [Hair].

    Hair from a Fey

  • [Hair].

    Leaves

  • [Hide].

    Bark

**Damage:** 1d8 slashing (or 1d10 slashing versatile) | **Properties:** Versatile | **Weight:** 3 lb | **Value:** 15 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

**Damage:** 1d10 piercing | **Properties:** Ammunition, Loading, Two-Handed | **Weight:** 10 lb | **Value:** 500 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

**Wooden Ammunition.** Wooden ammunition is destroyed after hitting or missing a target.

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

*Simple Weapon, rare (by a ranger)*

**Damage:** 2d4 piercing | **Properties:** Ammunition, GC:VSS-F, Light, GC:VSS-Re, GC:VSS-I | **Weight:** 1 lb | **Value:** 75 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

The smallest usable firearm, a Parlor Gun can be tucked into a stocking or hidden down a sleeve for two barrels of point-blank fire.

*Ranged Weapon, legendary (by a ranger)*

**Damage:** 2d8 piercing | **Properties:** AF, RLD | **Weight:** 3 lb

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

**Damage:** 1d6 piercing | **Properties:** Finesse, Light | **Weight:** 2 lb | **Value:** 10 gp

---

These weapons are carved from bark, with a core of magical sap, and decorated with leaves from magical plants. Their hilts and shafts are bound in hair from a fey creature. This magic weapon channels the natural magic found in the elements of nature.

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

**Crafting.** Creating a Monster Hunter's Weapon requires a Workshop and the following Components of rarity equal to the item's rarity:

- **[Animus].** Any Animus
- **[Fluid].** Sap
- **[Hair].** Hair from a Fey
- **[Hair].** Leaves
- **[Hide].** Bark

While holding this magic weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it, and you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and the saving throw DCs of your Ranger spells. The bonus is determined by the weapon's rarity. In addition, you can use the weapon as a Spellcasting Focus|XPHB for your Ranger spells.

When you hit with an attack using this weapon, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the same action used to make the attack. When you cast Hunter's Mark in this way it does not require Concentration|XPHB. Additionally, the spell lasts for one minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again using either the weapon or otherwise.

name: Necromancer's Leather Armor
descriptionMarkdown:
*Light Armor, rare (by a spellcaster)*

**Armor Class:** 11 | **Weight:** 10 lb | **Value:** 10 gp

---

This suit of armor is constructed from the bones of the dead and outfitted over black woven fabric. The armor has two skulls as pauldrons upon the shoulders, a reinforced spine, and a rib cage that covers the front, and the entire structure is ornately decorated with the fangs of fallen beasts. The bones are magically imbued with otherworldly energy, powered by a powerful undead animus.

While attuned to this armor, you are proficient with this armor even if you lack proficiency with light armor.

While you are within 30 feet of an Undead creature under your control, you gain Resistance|XPHB to all damage except Radiant. However, each time you take damage, choose an Undead creature under your control within 30 feet of you. That creature takes the same amount of damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way.

**Crafting.** Creating Necromancer's Armor requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Undead Animus
- **[Bones].** Ribs
- **[Bones].** Skull
- **[Bones].** Spine
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Natural Weapon].** Teeth

The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.

descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear, uncommon*

---

This sickly-looking potion contains a writhing mass of tentacles that animate and uncomfortably crawl down the imbiber's throat when consumed. The taste is pungent and fishy, and results in the sudden outbreak of random, but temporary, mutations.

When you consume this potion, you gain the effects of one randomly determined Mutation until you start a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB. You can roll on the Mutations table twice, choosing which mutation manifests. You don't gain any Contamination levels as a result of this Mutation. When the effect ends, your body returns to normal.

**Crafting.** Creating a Potion of Controlled Mutation requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

- **[Animus].** Animus from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor
- **[Organs].** Any two Organs from an Aberration

name: Rapier Between Worlds
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d8 piercing | **Properties:** Finesse | **Weight:** 2 lb | **Value:** 25 gp

---

This otherworldly blade is made from starmetal steel; a potent alloy produced by combining iron with carbon extracted from the bones of powerful aberrant creatures.  During the forging process, the blade is quenched in the spinal fluids of a Far Dweller to draw out extraplanar forces. The resulting metal has an octarine sheen that reflects possible worlds and other realities. The grip and crossguard are decorated with the barbs and leather of a Warp Marauder, and the pommel is set with a crystal containing the eldritch essence of a Far Dweller that powers the weapon's magic.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this magic weapon.

Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit|XPHB or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB using this weapon, immediately after the attack you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 120 feet you can see. Additionally, once per turn when you teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another creature while wielding this weapon, you can make one weapon attack against that creature with this weapon as part of the same action or Bonus Action|XPHB made to teleport.

While holding the blade, you can use a Magic action to cast Dimension Door. Once you do, you must finish a short or Long Rest|XPHB before you can use this feature again.

**Curse.** You have Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws against any spell or other effect which would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane of existence.

**Crafting.** Creating a Sword Between Worlds requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberration Animus
- **[Bones].** Skull, Spine, or Ribs from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor from a Far Dweller
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration
- **[Natural Weapon].** Tentacles from a Warp Marauder

name: Scimitar Between Worlds
descriptionMarkdown:
*Melee Weapon, very rare (Requires Attunement)*

**Damage:** 1d6 slashing | **Properties:** Finesse, Light | **Weight:** 3 lb | **Value:** 25 gp

---

This otherworldly blade is made from starmetal steel; a potent alloy produced by combining iron with carbon extracted from the bones of powerful aberrant creatures.  During the forging process, the blade is quenched in the spinal fluids of a Far Dweller to draw out extraplanar forces. The resulting metal has an octarine sheen that reflects possible worlds and other realities. The grip and crossguard are decorated with the barbs and leather of a Warp Marauder, and the pommel is set with a crystal containing the eldritch essence of a Far Dweller that powers the weapon's magic.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made using this magic weapon.

Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit|XPHB or reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB using this weapon, immediately after the attack you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 120 feet you can see. Additionally, once per turn when you teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of another creature while wielding this weapon, you can make one weapon attack against that creature with this weapon as part of the same action or Bonus Action|XPHB made to teleport.

While holding the blade, you can use a Magic action to cast Dimension Door. Once you do, you must finish a short or Long Rest|XPHB before you can use this feature again.

**Curse.** You have Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws against any spell or other effect which would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane of existence.

**Crafting.** Creating a Sword Between Worlds requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

- **[Animus].** Aberration Animus
- **[Bones].** Skull, Spine, or Ribs from an Aberration
- **[Fluid].** Contaminated Ichor from a Far Dweller
- **[Hide].** Skin from an Aberration
- **[Natural Weapon].** Tentacles from a Warp Marauder

name: Shard
descriptionMarkdown:
*Adventuring Gear*

**Weight:** 1 lb | **Value:** 500 gp

---

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.

A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

| Crystal Size | Market Value | Weight | AC | HP | Extraction Time |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Chip | 10 gold | 1/4 lbs | 15 | 5 | 1 action |
| Fragment | 100 gold | 1/2 lbs | 17 | 10 | 1 minute |
| Shard | 500 gold | 1 lbs | 19 | 15 | 5 minutes |
| Crystal | 1,000 gold | 2 lbs | 21 | 20 | 30 minutes |
| Geode | 5,000 gold | 20 lbs + | 23 | 25 | 1 hour |
| Massive Cluster | Priceless | 8,000 lbs + | 25 | 50 | 7 days |

**Delerium Properties.** All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

- Immunity|XPHB|Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
- Resistance|XPHB|Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
- Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.
- Unless contained within an Antimagic Field, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points|XPHB. However, delerium geodes release a random Arcane Anomalies when destroyed.

**Delerium Hazards.** When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

**Delerium Harvesting.** Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

**Uses for Delerium.** Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

**Spell Component.** Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

**Magic Items.** Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

**Stable Delerium.** The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

**Delerium Dust.** Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an Antimagic Field. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons|XPHB & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

descriptionMarkdown:
*Wondrous Item, legendary*

---

The inner workings of this clockwork device are formed from gears forged from magical constructs gathered around a focusing lens, held together carefully by the needles of magical creatures. The animus used harnesses the energy of The Algorithm, a being of order and consequence, whose control over time and space ripples from the strange clockworks of the medallion.

descriptionHtml:
This large greataxe is made from a blade taken off a Ripper and refitted into a housing made from the plates of constructs and reinforced with the rib bones of a monstrosity. The blade is equipped with a leather belt that connects to an elemental-fueled motor powered by a Very Rare Animus.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Once on your turn when you hit a Bloodied|XPHB creature using this weapon, you can make one additional attack with this weapon as part of the same action.

Crafting.

Creating a Whirling Bonesaw requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

  • [Animus].

    Any Animus

  • [Bones].

    Ribs

  • [Fluid].

    Elemental Fluid

  • [Hide].

    Plates

  • [Hide].

    Skin from any Monstrosity

  • [Natural Weapon].

    Blade from a Ripper
